title: Spec store milestones
description: The outcomes a spec store's plan works toward. Lives at openspec/milestones.yaml, beside plan.yaml. Optional: without it, the project is one milestone that holds every planned change.

schema_version.description: Version of this format. Readers refuse versions they do not support.

story_ref.description: <change-name>/<deliverable id>: one story of a change's breakdown.

depends_on.description: Milestones that come before this one.

includes.description: Whole changes or single stories. A change brings its stories and the tasks.md items its tasks setting selects.

gate.description: The story whose completion proves the milestone done. Without one, the milestone is done when all it includes is done.

goal.description: The milestone the project works toward. At most one milestone sets it.

tasks.description: Which of the change's tasks.md items count here: agent (untagged), metal, operator, or all. Default all. Its stories count with agent and all.
